features.note: 1U 19in chassis, envelope 482.6 x 43.0 x 559.0 mm exact (43.0 within the 44.45 1U slot, depth 13.0x height). Ears carry 2 visible mounting bores each. Containment: Y absolute (a 1U over-height fouls rack neighbours), the only exception the declared 5 mm front-protrusion allowance for the pluggable connector, said aloud in the guard.

9 module positions, present AND visible. The partial state shows 6 populated bays (handle + green LED) + 3 smooth blank plates (no handle/LED), MÓDULOS 6/9, with the invariant holding: bays always sum to 9 across modules and blanks.
3 PSU bays with state LEDs (blue standby / green enabled), separable from the module bank.
The NMC bay (far left) shows the RJ45 as a dark CAVITY inside its metallic cage (un-buried in optimization) plus the alarm block — the dark cavity the critical requires, not a metallic rectangle.

PANDUIT + PXTC1ARA reads; the catalogue number IS printed (P1 names the variant), no rating IS (the 4.8-6 kW in P1 describes the SYSTEM; printing it would claim this unit's LABEL, which the evidence does not describe). No display: a DOCUMENTED absence, asserted via a graph walk for any display/screen/lcd mesh (finds none), so a later pass cannot add one without failing.

important_features.note: Blue standby -> green enabled reads (1977 green-dominant px in enabled), judged on the rendered pixel per-channel.
Deep 559 mm body (13x height) reads at the near-horizontal el 3 hero.

Historical note, resolved: this asset passed three gates (mine included) with the ENTIRE FRONT buried in a solid box; the recovery (front un-buried + RJ45/NMC/ear-hole un-burials + the 'drawn but never seen' visibility check added to the ladder) is what makes the final correct.
corrections: None. Scene/library: carry the visibility ('present AND visible') check and frameBars() into any reuse.

mechanical.notes: 12/12 suites (trace, struct, framing, light, materials, surface, tonemap, legibility, optimization, p6, boot, float). Console clean; offline clean (importmap -> ./vendor/three/). Budget 82/200 draws, 2176/350000 tris, 19 unique geometries cache-covered. THE CHECK THAT MATTERS HERE: every critical is verified not just PRESENT but VISIBLE — a ray from each resolved camera position must reach its observer-facing surface — because this asset passed three gates with everything present, attached, right-sized, counted and complete while the whole front was buried; presence is not visibility. Result: 5/5 criticals present AND visible in both declared views; 0 of 82 visible meshes unreachable. 11 materials 0 drift all rendered; 4/4 UI controls with DOM button + URL state; state matrix (psu x modules) invariants hold. Also fixed a p6_comparison check that matched a YAML COMMENT ('# p6_comparison: SPEC-ONLY...') and reported its prose as the value — anchored to a real key line now (read the PARSE, not the document — the spec-never-parsed lesson). p6_comparison spec-only, references/ empty, no fabricated reference-match. Boot clean.

notes: FINAL gate — inline orchestrator judgment. The fmps-panduit asset is COMPLETE. Its defining lesson is PRESENCE IS NOT VISIBILITY: it passed three gates with the entire front buried in a solid box — nine faces, three PSU faces, thirteen LEDs, the RJ45, every divider and cavity — rendering only four protruding pieces, until a held HUE critical exposed it. The recovery was thorough and generalising: the front un-buried, three more burials of the same class found by the new 'drawn but never seen' visibility instrument (which now backstops the whole ladder and would have caught this three passes earlier), the class eliminated with a frameBars() helper, and lamp hue re-judged on the rendered pixel per-channel. The final asset is honest and correct — the catalogue number printed because it is evidenced, the rating withheld because the label is not, the display absent because P1 says so (and asserted so), and four open items held rather than invented. Cleared. Remaining run work: the scene assembly (the seventh and last).
